content.comment_body: Hello. I want to reset the latching relay using one of the inputs connected to the AND logic block. More precisely, I would like the latching relay to reset when any of those active inputs turns inactive.
There are three inputs connected to the AND block. Do you want to reset the latching relay when one or more of these inputs become low?

I want to reset the relay when any of these inputs become inactive (low). For example, if Input 2 is active and Inputs 3 and 4 are inactive, I'd like to use Input 2 to reset the latching relay when it switches to inactive. Thank you.
I'm not sure I understand. Should the relay reset only when all three inputs are low, or just when one of them is?
Only when all three inputs are low.

analysis.insight_summary: The discussion centers on resetting a latching relay when specific conditions are met with multiple inputs connected to an AND logic block. The user clarifies through several replies that the relay should only reset when all input signals become inactive. The exchange focuses entirely on relay logic configuration and there are no remarks—positive or negative—regarding the product itself.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects a straightforward setup to reliably reset the relay when all defined inputs are inactive.
